english-literature.unseen-adlestrop.0002.all: Adlestrop: late June afternoon, willows, willow-herb, meadowsweet, haycocks; birds of Oxfordshire and Gloucestershire; four quatrains; simple, still; ends in expanding birdsong.

english-literature.unseen-adlestrop.0001.all: Moment: express train stops unexpectedly; steam hissed, throat cleared, nothing happens; silence then blackbird; memory; 'Yes. I remember' conversational; widening focus.

english-literature.unseen-blake-london.0.all: London: chartered streets, Thames, midnight streets; cries and curses heard rather than seen; repetition of 'every', 'charter'd'; ABAB quatrains; streets of misery and oppression.
City life: poverty, institutional oppression; chimney sweeper, soldier, harlot; 'mind-forg'd manacles'; sound imagery; quatrains with regular ABAB, iambic tetrameter.

english-literature.unseen-break-break.00.all: Plan (Tennyson Break, Break, Break; the sea): Sea breaking on cold grey stones; speaker cannot utter thoughts; contrast of children/sailors' happiness with lost 'vanish'd hand'; 4 quatrains, refrain, short irregular lines mimic waves.

Plan (Tennyson Break, Break, Break; grief): Opening imperative, inability to speak, envy of others' joy, 'tender grace of a day that is dead', refrain returns; elegy for Hallam; sound of waves as grief.

note: cold answers carried over from the first checker run (written before any mark scheme was opened)
